create_inhouse_worker: create a new InhouseWorker instance by registering a worker ID with the MephistoDB and provider datastore
block_worker: block an InhouseWorker for a specified reason by setting their blocked status in the datastore
unblock_worker: unblock a previously blocked InhouseWorker by clearing their blocked status in the datastore
check_worker_authorization: check if an InhouseWorker is authorized for a task run by validating their name against an authorization CSV file
send_feedback_message: send a feedback message to an InhouseWorker for a given unit with debug logging
